fallacies.explanation: Trump dismisses Mitt Romney by calling him a 'RINO' (Republican In Name Only) instead of addressing Romney's political positions.
Trump attacks Romney's character by labeling him a 'RINO' rather than addressing his arguments or actions.
Trump describes Biden as 'angry and crazy' to evoke an emotional reaction rather than providing a logical critique of Biden's speech.
Trump misrepresents Mitt Romney's opposition to his 2024 candidacy as something trivial by calling him a 'RINO' instead of addressing Romney's actual reasons.
